messages.author: c901bb3747660a9c
messages.subject: Using fig.cap with markdown
parts:
I have troubles with the following example:

sample_knit_.md contains:

# Some heading

<!--roptions dev="png"-->

<!--begin.rcode settings, echo=FALSE
render_markdown()
end.rcode-->

Some code and a figure:
<!--begin.rcode fig1, fig.cap="Some caption"
a <- 1:10
plot(a)
end.rcode-->


I then run:

R -e "library(knitr); knit('sample_knit_.md')"

But in the resulting document I always get:

![plot of chunk fig1](fig1.png)

Is there a way to obtain:

![Some caption](fig1.png)

Thanks for any hints

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Using fig.cap with markdown
parts:
Hi,

This is a new feature in version 0.5 which is still under development.
You can install the latest development version from Github:
https://github.com/yihui/knitr#readme
